voices.training: See: https://brycebeattie.com/files/tts/ US English female voice. Single speaker. Trained from scratch for 1000 epochs on medium quality settings using the LJ Speech dataset. I reencoded the recordings to a bit rate of 22500 Hz so it would match other voices released for Piper TTS.
